answers.question: What functionality and division of responsibility does the supplied view communicate? Cite displayed references or wording.
answers.answer: The entry module is a package-facing barrel that exposes merge APIs and the Merge type while delegating implementation. The runtime engine folds newcomers left-to-right, recursively merges plain objects, and replaces other values. Its compare variant applies a callback after recursive merging to every incoming own property. A separate array policy concatenates two arrays shallowly and otherwise selects the newcomer; mergeAndConcat feeds this policy into the engine. The type-only machinery approximates the resulting shape through ordered deep merging and recursive prettification, with special optional/required-key handling. These responsibilities are presented as a composed summary.
